glosses: posiadający krawędź z ostro zakończonymi, pochylonymi, drobnymi wcięciami i klapkami
Having tooth-like projections on one side, as in a saw.

examples.text: Many click beetles have serrate antennae.

glosses: Of leaves: having tooth-like projections pointed away from the petiole.
To cut or divide in a jagged way.

examples.text: I [...] set off to check the other sheltered valleys that serrate the east side of Lundy.
